name: Will replacing the glass unit also fix issues with the sliding door frame or rollers?

mainEntity.name: Will replacing the glass unit also fix issues with the sliding door frame or rollers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing the glass unit itself will primarily address the issue of foggy or broken glass. It typically does not automatically fix problems with the sliding door frame, rollers, or track. However, during the glass replacement process, it's an opportune time for our technicians to inspect other components of your sliding door system. We can identify and recommend solutions for worn rollers, damaged tracks, or misaligned frames, and often provide those repairs concurrently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacing the glass unit fixes the glass issue. It does not automatically fix frame or roller problems, but technicians can inspect and address these during the process.
